description: Common, specialty and niche Indian-market medicines. Catalogue identity only: no stock, price or pharmacy association.

sources.retail-listings: Product facts (composition, strength, form) read from at least one Indian pharmacy or distributor listing per record (URLs in each record). Facts only; no text, images or prices were copied. These are not regulator records.
sources.manufacturer-document: A manufacturer's own product information (Alkem, GSK India, Sanofi India, Torrent, ...) agrees with the listing.
sources.multiple-sources: Two or more independent sources, including a regulator or manufacturer document, agree.
sources.official-list: Generic names, strengths and forms taken from the Government of India's Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) product list, published as an annexure by the Press Information Bureau. Public government information; the record cites the PMBJP drug code.
sources.single-source: Only one source was found for the composition, strength and form (a listing, or one regulator document). Treat as needing a second source.
